title: Secret Transmission from the Master
next_chapter_hook: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly in the night wind, his warning words like ice picks piercing into Chen Ji's ears—on the sect competition, someone had already set a lethal trap, waiting for him to step into the deadly ground.

text.content: Midnight approaches, the cold moon hangs like a hook. Chen Ji stands in the withered bamboo forest at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, the soil beneath his feet still bearing the scorch marks from the fire three years ago. This is where he first met Mo Xiansheng, and where his father Chen Xuan left his final footprints. The night wind whistles through the dead bamboo, mournful as if whispering unspeakable secrets. He tightens the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve, his fingertips radiating a faint warmth.

dialogue.content: "You came." The aged voice came from all directions, without physical form, only a faint azure light gathering in the depths of the bamboo grove. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul was even more faded than before, nearly merging with the moonlight, yet those deep eyes still held the sharpness of one who sees through all things. "About my father's death—" Before Chen Ji could finish, Mo Xiansheng raised his hand to stop him.

text.content: "No rush." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted closer, those invisible eyes scanning Chen Ji as if examining a treasured artifact finally rediscovered after years of dust. "The Tianji Record Fragment in your body has already resonated with your bloodline, faster than I anticipated. It seems the Chen family's bloodline compatibility with the Tianji Record is far greater than I imagined." Chen Ji frowned, an unease rising in his heart. "What does Master mean by these words?"

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a low laugh, carrying inexplicable complex emotions. "What do I mean? Lad, do you know why the Tianji Record would choose you specifically? A servant disciple of Tianqing Sect, with no talent, no background—why would such an ancient divine artifact fall into your hands?" Chen Ji remained silent, gazing steadily at Mo Xiansheng. The old man seemed not to expect an answer, continuing on his own: "Because the Tianji Record never chooses people—it chooses blood. The Chen bloodline is the sole key to unlocking this scroll of heavenly secrets."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The Chen family bloodline. These four words struck his heart like a heavy hammer. He recalled the grip of his father Chen Xuan's hand on his wrist as he lay dying, the desperate gaze in his mother's eyes the night she vanished with his sister, and the humiliation and endurance he had suffered all these years, branded as worthless. So from the very beginning, nothing was coincidental. "Therefore, the Tianji Record chose me—" "Because you carry the direct Chen family bloodline in your veins." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly turned ice-cold. "And because you are the only person in hundreds of years to possess both the 'foresight of heavenly secrets' and the 'bearing of backlash' dual constitution. In other words, you are the Tianji Record's tool, and also its sacrifice."

choice.prompt: Facing the cruel truth revealed by Mo Xiansheng, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.text: Inquire about his father's connection to the Tianji Record
choices.description: Since fate was determined long ago, he needs to know how his father connected with the Tianji Record, and whether he experienced the same struggle.
choices.visible_reward: Understand the complete history of the Chen family and the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Reopening old wounds may destabilize the Dao heart

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, a trace of reminiscence flickering in those ethereal eyes. "Your father, Chen Xuan, was the previous master of the Tianji Record." His voice was low. "But he understood better than anyone that the price of the Tianji Record was too heavy. He wanted to destroy it, to sever the Chen family's connection to this cursed object. Unfortunately—he failed."

text.content: Upon hearing the word "failure," Chen Ji's heart felt as if gripped by an invisible hand. His father's bloodshot eyes at death's door—he still remembered them clearly. That was no ordinary despair of a dying man, but the extreme frustration of seeing through something yet being powerless to change it. "So his death—" "Was related to the Tianji Record." Mo Xiansheng said this cruel truth calmly. "Every glimpse of the future comes at the cost of Heavenly Fate Value. When the Heavenly Fate Value is exhausted, that is the master's death. Your father spent thirty years depleting his own Heavenly Fate Value."

choices.text: Question whether he is merely a tool
choices.description: If everything was predetermined, what meaning do his struggles and schemes over the years have? He needs an answer, even if that answer would damn him forever.
choices.visible_cost: The Dao heart may be damaged
choices.risk_hint: Excessive self-doubt may lead one into demonic obstruction

dialogue.content: "Tool? Sacrifice?" Chen Ji suddenly laughed—that smile carried self-mockery, a hint of madness, yet also a resolve to burn all bridges. "Master, I ask you—if I am a tool, what were my carefully laid plans all these years for? If I am a sacrifice, why did I climb back from the gates of death time and again?" His eyes blazed with a fierce light, that was the astonishing will born from being driven to the brink. "Chen Ji never believes in fate. If heaven wants me dead, I shall defy heaven."

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly, then burst into a hearty laugh. "Good! Excellent! 'If heaven wants me dead, I shall defy heaven!'" That laughter carried relief, anticipation, and a deeply hidden sorrow. "Chen Xuan spoke the same words back then. Unfortunately, he ultimately could not escape the chessboard. But you—" Mo Xiansheng's gaze suddenly became profound beyond measure, "perhaps truly have the possibility to walk a different path."

choices.description: Rather than drowning in emotions, it is better to pragmatically seek a way out. He needs to know how to control the power of the Tianji Record, rather than being consumed by its backlash.
choices.visible_cost: Requires an additional price to pay
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the foundational heart method to control the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Any secret technique carries side effects

dialogue.content:
"Master," Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to remain calm, "Since the Tianji Record has chosen me, since I am destined to bear this cost—do you have a way to let me control it, rather than be devoured by it?"

Mo Xiansheng looked at Chen Ji, his appreciation deepening.
"You are more pragmatic than your father." He nodded. "Very well, teaching a man to fish is better than giving him fish. Today I shall pass you a beginner heart method called the 'Heart Stabilizing Art,' which can temporarily suppress the Tianji Record's side effects, reducing your backlash by three-tenths each time you use it."

text.content:
As Mo Xiansheng's voice fell, a green light flew from his remnant soul into Chen Ji's brow center. That light carried an immense stream of information, flooding into his Mental Sea like a river breaking its dam. Chen Ji felt his head splitting with pain, but gritted his teeth and persevered, allowing those obscure characters to reorganize and fuse within his mind.

After a moment, he opened his eyes, a sharp light flickering in his gaze.
"The Heart Stabilizing Art—I've already memorized it."

Wind suddenly stirred in the Bamboo Grove. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul wavered in the breeze, as if it might dissipate at any moment. He glanced at the faint white light creeping along the horizon, his expression grave.
"My time is running out." His voice became urgent. "Chen Ji, what I'm about to say, you must remember firmly."

Chen Ji's expression tensed as he bowed. "Please instruct me, Master."

dialogue.content:
"What became of your father—I am not entirely ignorant."

Mo Xiansheng's words struck like thunder in Chen Ji's mind. He jerked his head up, staring intently at that illusory figure.
"That night three years ago, Chen Xuan did not die." Mo Xiansheng's voice was low. "He was taken by the Heavenly Eye—or rather, he voluntarily entered the Heavenly Eye's chess game. As for the reason—"

He paused, as if debating whether to continue.
"Because he discovered that the true secret of the Tianji Record lies with the Heavenly Eye."

text.content:
Chen Ji felt his heart pounding violently, blood surging through his veins.

His father was not dead. This news was like a beam of light piercing the darkness in his heart, illuminating the road ahead. But simultaneously, another thought loomed over him like dark clouds—the Heavenly Eye, an existence utterly beyond his current reach.
"Master, what exactly is the Heavenly Eye?"

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng shook his head, his remnant soul growing ever fainter.
"Telling you now would be premature. You only need to remember one point—the Heavenly Eye is not a mere enemy. It is a transcendent consciousness existing within the laws of heaven. It treats all prophets as chess pieces; the Tianji Record is merely one of its many pieces placed in the mortal realm."

His voice grew increasingly虚弱.
"Your father chose to enter its chess game because he wanted to shatter the game from within. And you—"

A complex emotion flickered in Mo Xiansheng's eyes.
"You may be the final move he left behind."

choice.prompt: Facing the astonishing news that his father might still be alive, Chen Ji's next reaction was:

choices.text: Inquire about the clues left behind by his father
choices.description: Since his father had long ago set up a plan, he must have left certain things behind. He needed to find those clues and accelerate his own growth.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the hidden legacy left by his father

dialogue.content:
"Master, did my father leave any clues before he left?" Chen Ji's voice was urgent yet restrained. "Anything will do—a token, a location, or even a single phrase."

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul nodded slightly, as if he had anticipated this question.
"Chen Xuan always acted with meticulous precision. Before he left, he concealed something in the Forbidden Grounds of the Tianqing Sect."

text.content:
"That object is protected by layers of formations; ordinary people cannot approach it." Mo Xiansheng's voice grew increasingly ethereal. "But you are of Chen bloodline—those formations are not insurmountable for you."

He separated a wisp of green light from his remnant soul, which entered Chen Ji's brow center. In an instant, a map appeared in Chen Ji's mind, marking a secret entrance in the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain.
"Remember—before the timing is right, do not attempt this recklessly. Otherwise—" Mo Xiansheng's words suddenly stopped.

choices.text: Ask about the Heavenly Eye's weaknesses
choices.description: Since his father dared to walk into the tiger's den, he must have had his own backing. He needed to understand what the enemy was to formulate a targeted plan.
choices.visible_reward: Learn partial truths about the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: The truth may be more terrifying than imagined

dialogue.content:
"Master, does the Heavenly Eye have weaknesses?" Chen Ji's gaze was sharp as a blade. "Since my father dared to enter the game, he surely did not act rashly."

Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment, seemingly weighing whether he should speak.
"There is." In the end, he spoke. "Though the Heavenly Eye is powerful, it is not omniscient. It can only observe the world and intervene in reality through prophets. In other words—"

text.content:
"In other words, prophets are its eyes, but also its shackles." Chen Ji took up the words, his eyes gleaming. "As long as prophets do not act according to the trajectories it has set, its arrangements will deviate."

"You are a quick learner." Mo Xiansheng let out a soft sigh. "But remember—the Heavenly Eye has existed for millennia. Its patience is beyond anything you can imagine. It can wait, wait for you to make mistakes, wait for you to despair, wait for you to willingly walk into the traps it has set. Until then—"

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul had grown so faint it was nearly invisible.
"Until then, you must survive."

His voice was like a candle flame in the wind, ready to extinguish at any moment.
"There is one more thing I must warn you about—the Sect Competition three days from now, someone has set a lethal trap. That person has countless connections to the Heavenly Eye, and their purpose is to draw you into their game. You—"

Before he could finish, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul completely dissolved into the night breeze, leaving only a final sentence echoing through the Bamboo Grove:

"Be extremely careful."

text.content:
The Bamboo Grove fell into silence, only the sound of wind mournful in his ears.

Chen Ji stood motionless on the spot, as if he had turned to stone. Mo Xiansheng's words echoed ceaselessly in his mind, each character branding deep marks in his heart like a searing iron.

Chen bloodline. Key to the Tianji Record. His father's arrangement. The Heavenly Eye's chess game.

All of this intertwined, forming a magnificent scroll. And he, Chen Ji, had unknowingly already stood at the very center of this scroll.

"He slowly raised his hand, gazing at the Tianji Record Fragment glowing faintly in his palm.

This thing had chosen his bloodline, yet it was destined to devour his life. His father had taken thirty years to walk toward death, and he—

"No."

Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice low but resolute.

"I will not follow in my father's footsteps."

He lifted his head, eyes blazing, gazing toward the direction of the Tianqing Sect Main Peak. There, countless schemes were brewing in the shadows. The Sect Competition three days later would be the greatest test since his rebirth."

choice.prompt: "Facing the upcoming Sect Competition, Chen Ji needed to make preparations:"

choices.text: "Immediately enter seclusion to cultivate the Heart-Stabilizing Art"
choices.description: "The Heart-Stabilizing Art taught by Mo Xiansheng was what he needed most to master at present. Only with a solid foundation could he handle various unexpected situations during the Competition."
choices.visible_reward: "Heart-Stabilizing Art reaches minor accomplishment, foresight backlash alleviated"
choices.risk_hint: "Closed-door cultivation may cause missed intelligence gathering"

text.content:
"Chen Ji turned and left the Bamboo Grove, returning to his secluded Servants' Quarters.

Three days was enough for him to cultivate the Heart-Stabilizing Art to minor accomplishment. Though he couldn't completely eliminate the side effects of the Tianji Record, it would at least allow him to endure one more foresight in critical moments.

He sat cross-legged, following the method taught by Mo Xiansheng, beginning to adjust his breathing and condense his mind. Gradually, a faint azure light appeared around him, isolating him from the aura of the Tianji Record."

"However, just as Chen Ji was about to delve deeper into cultivation, urgent knocking came from the door.

"Chen Ji! Chen Ji, are you there?"

It was Su Qingyao's voice, carrying rare anxiety.

Chen Ji frowned slightly, stood up, and opened the door. Su Qingyao stood outside, dressed in night attire, her face full of anxiety and worry.

"What's wrong?"

choices.description: "Better to take the initiative than to wait for death. He would use the Tianji Record to probe the enemy's plans in advance, to know himself and his enemy."
choices.visible_reward: "Foresight the content of the Competition trap in advance"
choices.risk_hint: "Overuse of Tianji Record may cause backlash"

text.content:
"Chen Ji did not return to his room but turned toward another secluded corner of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain.

He was going to use the Tianji Record. Not to peer into the future aimlessly, but to specifically examine the scene of the Sect Competition three days later. Mo Xiansheng had said someone had set a trap, so he needed to know in advance what this trap truly was.

He sat cross-legged, took out the Tianji Record Fragment, and pressed it against his Brow Center. A faint golden light flickered in his eyes."

"Three breaths later, images materialized before Chen Ji's eyes.

On the Arena Platform of the Sect Competition, a sea of people. He saw himself standing on the platform, facing an unexpected opponent. Further away, the old sect master Ling Yuan sat on the high platform, a meaningful smile playing at the corner of his lips.

That smile sent a chill down Chen Ji's heart.

The image abruptly blurred, and the Tianji Record brought intense backlash. His head throbbed with针刺般的疼痛, and a trickle of blood seeped from his nose."

"The sky had begun to glow with the first light of dawn, and the initial rays of morning light pierced through the night's veil.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, calming the surging qi and blood in his body. Mo Xiansheng's words still echoed in his ears, and the cultivation method of the Heart-Stabilizing Art had been deeply seared into his Mental Sea.

At the Sect Competition three days later, someone had set a Lethal Trap targeting him. And the meaningful smile of the old sect master Ling Yuan made his heart alarm bells ring even louder.

What role was this old fox playing in all this?"

"Chen Ji clenched his fists tight, his knuckles whitening from the force.

He had thought he had been careful enough, patient enough, playing the废物 (waste) persona flawlessly. But now it seemed every step of his had been under someone's control.

Heavenly Eye. The shackles of the Tianji Record. His father's unfinished cause.

All this burden had fallen upon the shoulders of this"废物" (waste)."

""Heh——"

Chen Ji suddenly laughed softly, that laughter carrying a hint of self-mockery, a hint of madness, but more than anything, a resolve to fight to the bitter end.

废物 (Waste)?

Since everyone thought he was a废物 (waste), then let this废物 (waste) give everyone a"surprise" at the Sect Competition three days later.

He lifted his head, morning light falling on his face, illuminating that sharp gleam in his eyes.

His father's chess game, he had accepted. The Heavenly Eye's chess game—

He would break it with his own hands."

dialogue.content:
"Morning birds sang in the Bamboo Grove, crisp and pleasant.

Chen Ji straightened his clothes, tucking the Tianji Record Fragment back into his sleeve. He gazed at the distant Tianqing Sect Main Peak, having already formed his plan.

In three days, he needed to make complete preparations. Cultivate the Heart-Stabilizing Art, investigate the identity of the layout mastermind, and find ways to deal with that old fox Ling Yuan.

Every step must be taken with utmost care, yet concealing deadly intent.

"The Competition, huh..." he murmured to himself, a dangerous curve appearing at the corner of his lips, "Since you all want to watch a show, I'll give you one hell of a performance."

text.content:
"When Chen Ji walked back to his Servants' Quarters, his mind was still反复思索着 (ruminating on) the information Mo Xiansheng had revealed.

Chen family bloodline. Key to the Tianji Record. His father actively entering the Heavenly Eye's chess game. The Lethal Trap in three days. The old sect master Ling Yuan's smile.

These seemingly unrelated fragments were gradually assembling into an increasingly clear picture in Chen Ji's mind.

He knew that from this night forward, he could no longer survive by maintaining the identity of an ordinary废物 (waste). The gears of fate had begun to turn, and he—must become the one who controls those gears."

"Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly in the night wind, his aged voice like something from ancient times, carrying urgency and worry: "Chen Ji, there is one more matter I nearly forgot. At the Sect Competition three days later, someone has already set a Lethal Trap. The one who laid this trap has concealed their methods so deeply that even I could only glimpse a corner of it. You must be especially careful, never underestimate your enemy—once you step onto the Arena Platform, life and death become uncertain."

As the words fell, the remnant soul completely dissipated, leaving only these words like an ice pick embedded in Chen Ji's heart."
